definitions.explanation: The discovery of artifacts, remains, or other items through archaeological excavation. Describes the act of something being dug up from the ground.

examples.japanese: ⟦{土器|どき}→土器：09658_doki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出土|しゅつど}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出土|しゅつど}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: Many excavated artifacts were found at this archaeological site.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}→工事現場：26202_koujigenba⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{銅鏡|どうきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出土|しゅつど}し、⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: An ancient bronze mirror was unearthed at the construction site, and an investigation is underway.

notes:
{出土|しゅつど} refers to the unearthing of artifacts, remains, or other items through archaeological excavation. A compound of {出|しゅつ} (come out) + {土|ど} (earth).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出土|しゅつど}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: excavated artifact
- {出土|しゅつど}⟦{遺物|いぶつ}→遺物：14545_ibutsu⟧: excavated relic
- ⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{出土|しゅつど}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be excavated from ruins
- ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出土|しゅつど}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be unearthed in large quantities

USAGE:
The subject is typically the item being unearthed, not the person doing the digging. For example: ⟦{土器|どき}→土器：09658_doki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出土|しゅつど}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ (earthenware was excavated). Common in archaeological reports, news about historical discoveries, and academic writing.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{発掘|はっくつ}→発掘：07995_hakkutsu⟧: excavation (the act of digging)
- ⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧: archaeological site, ruins
